title: The Part Library page accepts a number that differs from another entry only in letter case
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Lethbridge. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-LK1 (stocked at Staging Lethbridge only); QAPL-T5 (a different entry, stocked at Staging Heavy Duty only; confirm Staging Lethbridge has no QAPL-T5); QAPL-B1 (stocked at both locations); QAPL-T1 (stocked at Staging Heavy Duty).
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Part Library > open QAPL-LK1 > pencil > Part Number "qapl-t5" (QAPL-T5 in lower case) > Save.
  2. Part Library list > search "qapl-t5".
  3. Parts > Inventory (Staging Lethbridge) > search "qapl-t5".
  4. Part Library > open QAPL-B1 > pencil > Part Number "qapl-t1" > Save.
  5. Close the window with the X and reload QAPL-B1's detail page.
  6. Open the "qapl-t5" entry > pencil > Part Number "QAPL-LK1" > Save.
custom_expected:
1. Saved. No "Part number qapl-t5 already belongs to another part in the Part Library." toast (the case differs, so it is not an exact match); the detail page shows "qapl-t5" exactly as typed.
  2. Two separate entries are listed: "QAPL-T5" (unchanged) and "qapl-t5".
  3. The Lethbridge part (the former QAPL-LK1) reads "qapl-t5": renamed in place, same part.
  4. Refused, because Staging Heavy Duty stocks QAPL-B1 and holds the look-alike QAPL-T1: error toast "QAPL-T1 already exists at Staging Heavy Duty." with "Please try to resolve this." under it, fading after 3 seconds; the window stays open.
  5. QAPL-B1's number is unchanged.
  6. Saved; the entry and the Lethbridge part read "QAPL-LK1" again.
